key_insights: Bull market likely over after BTC broke 20-week MA at $46k; waiting for bounce to mid-40ks to exit
BTC needs to recover and lead for healthy market; current BTC weakness with ETH strength is concerning
ETH flipping BTC market cap possible if BTC recovers and ETH breaks 0.084-0.1 on ETH/BTC
DOGE pumping indicates retail dumb money still in market, which is negative for sustainable bull market
DeFi long-term bullish as banking alternative but currently overpriced and reflexive
On-chain trading is growing and becoming competitive with centralized exchanges
Having cash on sidelines provides position of power to take advantage of opportunities
summary: Ledger believes there's a >50% chance the bull market is over after BTC broke its 20-week moving average at $46k, but is waiting for a bounce to the $40-45k area to risk off. BTC needs to lead for a healthy market, but dominance has been decreasing since January. ETH flipping BTC is possible if BTC recovers and ETH breaks 0.084-0.1 on ETH/BTC. DOGE pumping indicates dumb retail money remains, which is negative. DeFi is long-term bullish as a banking alternative but currently overpriced. Having cash on sidelines provides position of power.
